line: Black-and-white cartoon on film: noodle limbs, pie-cut eyes, everything bounces to the beat.
line_cn: 黑白胶片卡通：面条四肢、派切眼睛，万物随节拍弹跳。
lineage: Structure after lemo-opuscar STYLE.md (CC BY 4.0); text written for the H3 pipeline.
essence: Monochrome ink on film: greys, a soft halo on whites, dust and a wobble in the gate.
Characters are tubes and circles: no elbows, no knees, white gloves, pie-cut pupils.
Everything is alive and bounces on the beat; objects have faces.
Gags are mechanical and readable at thumbnail size.
The music is a jazz band and every action is a note.
not: Not a modern flat vector cartoon: there is film grain and ink texture.
Not a horror pastiche: cheerful, not sinister.
materials: Ink line of even width, warm black on cream cel; grey washes for tone.
Film grain, light flicker, a slight weave; dust specks.
Backgrounds in soft pencil and wash.

rules: Greys only; white is a halo, black is ink.
Tone separates figure from ground: dark figures on light sets.
colour.examplePalette: cream #e9e2cf, light grey #b5ae9d, mid grey #6e685c, ink #1a1714

type.subtitleFont: a rounded sans, cream on dark
type.placement: title cards on their own; subtitles bottom centre
rules: A title card is a static shot with no picture, done by the assembler.
Bounce on every beat; squash and stretch on every landing.
Limbs swing like rope; bodies tilt with the music.
Hold a pose one beat before a gag.

grammar.expresses: the stage; the gag plays whole

grammar.note: side scroll with a looping background

framing: Full shots; a gag reads whole.
Faces big enough for the pie-cut eyes to read.

sound.ambience: the band in the room; no realistic beds
sound.silence: the band stops; a held pose; one tiny sound (a drip, a tick)
sound.voice: scat and nonsense syllables more than words; short lines
sound.musicDefault: hot jazz band, swing, every action a note

nativeMoves.name: Everything dances
nativeMoves.what: Objects and buildings bounce in time.
nativeMoves.build: loop link: one bar of bounce as FL2VA, repeat on the timeline.

nativeMoves.name: The stretch
nativeMoves.what: A limb or neck stretches across the frame to reach a thing.
nativeMoves.build: single beat 'the arm stretches like rubber across the room to…', camera static.

nativeMoves.name: Iris on the wink
nativeMoves.what: An iris closes on the hero's wink.
nativeMoves.build: assembler iris transition after a cu shot ending on a wink.

nativeMoves.name: Object with a face
nativeMoves.what: The product itself joins the dance.
nativeMoves.build: prop element described with eyes and gloves; reference mode.

pitfalls.problem: The model adds colour or modern shading.
pitfalls.fix: grade mono, texture 8mm or 16mm; say 'black and white 1930s ink cartoon' in the suffix.

pitfalls.problem: Limbs get elbows and realistic hands.
pitfalls.fix: Describe 'rubber-hose tube limbs, no joints, white gloves' in character elements.

pitfalls.problem: Gags are too fast to read.
pitfalls.fix: One gag per shot; hold a beat before and after.

look.genre: 1930s black-and-white rubber-hose cartoon short, musical gag comedy
look.palette: silver greys and warm ink on cream, film grain, no colour
look.camera: locked full shots, side scrolls, quick push-ins on reactions, iris in and out
look.lighting: flat; tone separates figure and ground

engine.beatSuffix: Black-and-white 1930s rubber-hose cartoon, tube limbs and pie-cut eyes, everything bouncing to the beat.

structures: a product's day told as a dance
openings: an iris opens on the band
a sleeping object wakes to the beat
